items.title: Marty Sheller interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 9, 2022
items.q: every one of the timbale players were influenced by Tito Puente... that was my introduction to Latin music... starting me off listening to Tito Puente

ctx.x: A Latin band. © Fillius Jazz Archive -7-

Yes. A very small Latin band. It was just timbales, piano, bass, and trumpet. No conga, no other Latin percussion. And as a matter of fact the timbale player, every one of the timbale players were influenced by Tito Puente. And I heard the timbale player play some of these licks that to me were new, and I thought this guy is a genius. Listen to these hip things that he’s playing. It was actually Tito Puente licks. But that was my introduction to Latin music.
This seems very interesting to me. This would have been mid-60s?
